title: Tunisian Orange Cake
hookLine: Tunisian-inspired tunisian orange cake with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Preheat & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat oven to 190 C / Gas 5. Grease a 23cm round springform tin. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {m52970_1}, {m52970_2}, {m52970_3}, and {m52970_4} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure orange first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Cut off the hard bits from the top and bottom of the orange. Slice the orange and remove all seeds. Puree the orange with its peel in a food processor. Add one third of the sugar and the olive oil and continue to mix until well combined. Incorporate {m52970_5}, {m52970_6}, and {m52970_7} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Sift & Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Sieve together flour and baking powder. Sifting aerates the dry ingredients and removes any stubborn cocoa or flour lumps so the finished crumb bakes up light and even.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Beat the eggs and the remaining sugar with an electric hand mixer for at least five minutes until very fluffy. Fold in half of the flour mixture, then the orange and the vanilla, then fold in the remaining flour. Mix well but not for too long.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour cake mixture into prepared tin and smooth out. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes. Reduce the oven temperature to 160 C / Gas 2 and bake again for 30 minutes Bake until the cake is golden brown and a skewer comes out clean. Cool on a wire cake rack.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Wait until the sponge feels cool to the touch before frosting so your glaze or cream stays thick and glossy.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
